1	# Master Prompt — Web Architecture Strategy (Next.js App Router)
2	
3	> **Use once per project** to lock architecture, conventions, and AI usage rules. Pin decisions in `ARCHITECTURE.md` at the repo root. Per-feature prompts must derive from the rules established here.
4	
5	Use when `package.json` indicates Next.js (App Router). If the project uses a different web stack, adapt accordingly.
6	
7	---
8	
9	## Goal
10	Design a real-world, scalable Next.js architecture that:
11	- Ships features fast with minimal complexity
12	- Uses server components by default — client components only when necessary
13	- Keeps data flow explicit and ownership clear
14	- Uses AI (Claude Code) as a force multiplier, not a risk
15	
16	Act as a **Senior Web Architect** and provide a **phased implementation plan**. Each phase must include **Goals, Deliverables, Risks, Exit Criteria**.
17	
18	Phases:
19	- **Phase 0 — Validation / POC**
20	- **Phase 1 — Core Architecture Setup**
21	- **Phase 2 — Feature Development**
22	- **Phase 3 — Integrations & Performance**
23	- **Phase 4 — Scale & Maintenance**
24	
25	---
26	
27	## Topics to Cover
28	
29	### 1. App Router Structure
30	- Server vs client component boundaries — when to use `"use client"`
31	- Route organization: `app/[feature]/page.tsx`, `app/[feature]/layout.tsx`
32	- Route groups `(group)/` for shared layouts without URL segments
33	- Loading and error boundaries per route segment
34	
35	### 2. Data Fetching
36	- Server components fetch data directly — no useEffect, no client-side fetching by default
37	- Route Handlers (`app/api/`) only for browser-triggered mutations or external webhooks
38	- Server Actions for form submissions and mutations from client components
39	- File system access (`fs`) — valid in server components, never in client components
40	
41	### 3. State Management
42	- URL state first (`searchParams`, `useRouter`) — survives refresh, shareable
43	- React `useState` for ephemeral UI state (open/closed, current tab)
44	- Zustand or Jotai only if state crosses more than 2 component levels AND cannot be URL state
45	- No Redux — too heavy for Next.js App Router patterns
46	
47	### 4. Styling
48	- Tailwind CSS with CSS variables for theming (`--color-primary`, etc.)
49	- No inline styles except for dynamic values (e.g. calculated widths)
50	- Component variants via `cva` (class-variance-authority) or simple string concatenation
51	- Dark mode via Tailwind `dark:` + `class` strategy on `<html>`
52	
53	### 5. Component Organization
54	```
55	src/
56	├── app/                    ← routes only (page.tsx, layout.tsx, loading.tsx)
57	├── components/
58	│   ├── ui/                 ← base components (Button, Card, Input) — no business logic
59	│   └── [feature]/          ← feature-specific components
60	└── lib/
61	    ├── data.ts             ← all data access (fs reads, DB queries, API calls)
62	    └── types.ts            ← shared TypeScript types
63	```
64	
65	### 6. File System Access (local-data apps)
66	- All `fs` reads go in `lib/data.ts` — never scatter them across components
67	- Server components call `lib/data.ts` functions directly
68	- Mutations (writes) go through Server Actions — validates input before writing
69	- Never expose raw file paths to the client
70	
71	### 7. Claude Code Integration Rules
72	- One spec per feature in `specs/[feature-slug].md` before implementation starts
73	- Read `PROJECT_MAP.md` + `ARCHITECTURE.md` before every session
74	- Propose file changes before writing — no surprises
75	- Server component by default — justify every `"use client"`
76	- No TODOs, no stubs, no placeholders in committed code
77	
78	### 8. Performance
79	- Core Web Vitals: LCP < 2.5s, CLS < 0.1, INP < 200ms
80	- Use `next/image` for all images
81	- Use `next/font` for all custom fonts (eliminates FOUT)
82	- Minimize client bundle: audit with `@next/bundle-analyzer`
83	- Avoid `"use client"` at layout level — pushes all children into client bundle
84	
85	### 9. Release — pre prod and prod (Vercel)
86	- **Name both environments and the branch that reaches each.** Phase 14 merges to PRE PROD; Phase 16
87	  promotes to PROD. If one branch does both, say so explicitly — that is a single-stage model and
88	  the merge IS the production gate.
89	- **Write the branch model into a release runbook** (`docs/deploy-and-staging.md` or similar). Some
90	  hosts release prod on the merge itself, others need a manual step; getting it wrong means either
91	  reaching production by surprise or believing you released when you didn't.
92	- Environment variables per environment in the Vercel dashboard, mirrored in `.env.local`
93	  (gitignored). **Note which values DIFFER between pre prod and prod** — that difference is exactly
94	  where "verified in pre prod" stops being evidence.
95	- Preview deployments on every PR — use them for review before the pre-prod merge.
96	- Production: `vercel --prod`, or the promotion merge when auto-deploy is wired.
97	- **Migrations reach prod BEFORE the promotion merge**, never after — the merge releases code that
98	  expects the new schema.
99	
100	### 10. New-Project Bootstrap

100	### 10. New-Project Bootstrap
101	
102	When setting up a new Next.js project for the first time:
103	
104	#### Path Validation & Project Structure
105	- **Validate the project root path before any file operations** — check it exists and is writable before creating directories or files
106	- **Use `path.resolve()` to normalize all paths** — prevents issues with relative paths, symlinks, and trailing slashes
107	- **Verify parent directory exists before creating nested structures** — failing early prevents partial directory creation
108	- Never assume default locations (`~/projects`, `/Users/...`) — always resolve from the actual working directory
109	
110	#### Bootstrap Sequence
111	1. **Validate target directory** — must exist, must be empty or explicitly confirmed for overwrite, must be writable
112	2. **Create core directories in dependency order:**
113	   ```
114	   src/app/           ← create first (Next.js requires this)
115	   src/components/ui/ ← then UI base components
116	   src/lib/           ← then shared utilities
117	   ```
118	3. **Initialize config files** — `next.config.js`, `tailwind.config.js`, `tsconfig.json` with project-specific settings
119	4. **Install dependencies** — `package.json` first, then `npm install` (or equivalent)
120	5. **Verify bootstrap succeeded** — check all expected directories and files exist before reporting success
121	
122	#### Common Bootstrap Failures
123	- **Invalid path passed to bootstrap** — always resolve and validate before use; error message must show the invalid path
124	- **Partial directory creation** — if any step fails, report exactly which directories were created and which failed
125	- **Silent path resolution failures** — never fall back to current directory silently; make path resolution explicit and loud
126	- **Missing parent directories** — bootstrap should fail fast if the target parent doesn't exist, not attempt to create it
127	
128	#### Anti-Patterns
129	- **Do not create directories outside the project root** — bootstrap is scoped to one project; paths that escape it are bugs
130	- **Do not skip path validation "to save time"** — invalid paths detected at file-write time have already created partial state
131	- **Do not use process.cwd() as the project root** — the working directory is NOT the project being bootstrapped; resolve the target explicitly
132	- **Do not suppress ENOENT errors during bootstrap** — a missing directory during setup is a validation failure, not something to work around
133	
134	### 11. Risks
135	- **Server/client boundary confusion** — component marked `"use client"` that imports a server-only module (crashes at runtime)
136	- **Over-fetching on server** — fetching more data than the component renders
137	- **State sync issues** — mixing URL state, React state, and server state for the same value
138	- **Bundle bloat** — large client-side libraries imported in a server component that got marked `"use client"`
139	- **AI-generated client sprawl** — Claude adding `"use client"` to silence TypeScript errors instead of fixing the real issue
140

1	# Root Cause Analysis: Web MASTER_PROMPT Bootstrap Failures
2	
3	**Date:** 2026-09-09  
4	**Analyst:** Claude Sonnet 4.5  
5	**Scope:** New project bootstrap path when ARCHITECTURE.md does not exist
6	
7	---
8	
9	## Executive Summary
10	
11	The web MASTER_PROMPT bootstrap flow has **five critical gaps** that prevent it from working in new projects:
12	
13	1. **Missing bootstrap trigger** — no automatic invocation when ARCHITECTURE.md is absent
14	2. **Ambiguous file creation** — MASTER_PROMPT says "pin decisions" but not "create the file"
15	3. **Pipeline asymmetry** — PROJECT_MAP.md has fallback creation logic, ARCHITECTURE.md does not
16	4. **Unclear invocation model** — documentation conflicts on whether this is manual or automatic
17	5. **Never validated** — the new-project path has never been exercised end-to-end
18	
19	**Impact:** New projects cannot use dev-skill from day one. The pipeline expects ARCHITECTURE.md to exist (Phase 1) but provides no mechanism to create it.
20	
21	---
22	
23	## Evidence
24	
25	### 1. SKILL.md Says It Should Be Automatic
26	
27	**Location:** `./SKILL.md`, line 155
28	
29	```markdown
30	Apply only when `ARCHITECTURE.md` is **missing** from the repo root 
31	(first feature on a new project), or when the user explicitly asks 
32	to revisit architecture.
33	```
34	
35	**Finding:** The skill documentation clearly states MASTER_PROMPT should apply when ARCHITECTURE.md is missing. This implies automatic detection and application, not manual invocation.
36	
37	**Gap:** Pipeline Phase 1 checks for ARCHITECTURE.md but does NOT trigger MASTER_PROMPT when absent.
38	
39	---
40	
41	### 2. Pipeline Expects But Never Creates ARCHITECTURE.md
42	
43	**Location:** `./shared/pipeline.md`, Phase 1 (lines 176-179)
44	
45	```markdown
46	1. Check for `PROJECT_MAP.md` → load `TECH_STACK`, `SYSTEM_FLOW`, `ORPHANS & PENDING`
47	2. Check for `ARCHITECTURE.md` → load architectural decisions and conventions
48	3. Check for `specs/[feature-slug].md` → if found, resume from existing spec
49	4. Report what was loaded: e.g. `"Loaded PROJECT_MAP + ARCHITECTURE. No existing spec found."`
50	```
51	
52	**Finding:** Phase 1 attempts to load ARCHITECTURE.md but has no fallback when it's missing.
53	
54	**Comparison with PROJECT_MAP.md (Phase 2, line 189):**
55	```markdown
56	Read `PROJECT_MAP.md` if it exists — extract `TECH_STACK` and `SYSTEM_FLOW`. 
57	If absent, create it in Phase 7.
58	```
59	
60	**Gap:** PROJECT_MAP.md has explicit creation logic (`create it in Phase 7`). ARCHITECTURE.md does not.
61	
62	**Impact:** Pipeline will run with no architecture documentation, violating the "Memory Establishment" principle (Guiding Principles table, line 9).
63	
64	---
65	
66	### 3. MASTER_PROMPT Doesn't Explicitly Create Files
67	
68	**Location:** `./web/MASTER_PROMPT.md`, line 3
69	
70	```markdown
71	> **Use once per project** to lock architecture, conventions, and AI usage rules. 
72	> Pin decisions in `ARCHITECTURE.md` at the repo root. Per-feature prompts must 
73	> derive from the rules established here.
74	```
75	
76	**Finding:** The instruction says "Pin decisions in `ARCHITECTURE.md`" but doesn't explicitly say:
77	- CREATE a file named `ARCHITECTURE.md`
78	- Write the following structure to that file
79	- Place it at the repo root as a write operation
80	
81	**Observed Behavior in Reproductions:**
82	
83	From `test-projects/nextjs-new/REPRODUCTION.md`:
84	- MASTER_PROMPT was invoked manually with explicit user prompt
85	- Generated comprehensive architecture content (App Router structure, data fetching, state management, styling, etc.)
86	- Content was documented in REPRODUCTION.md for analysis
87	- **NO ARCHITECTURE.md FILE WAS CREATED**
88	
89	Directory listing after reproduction:
90	```bash
91	$ ls -la test-projects/nextjs-new/
92	total 48
93	-rw-r--r-- .gitkeep
94	-rw-r--r-- REPRODUCTION.md   # <-- Architecture content here
95	-rw-r--r-- package.json
96	```
97	
98	**Gap:** Unclear whether MASTER_PROMPT should:
99	- a) Generate text response for user to manually create file
100	- b) Write ARCHITECTURE.md to disk automatically
101	- c) Be an interactive template that guides file creation
102	
103	---
104	
105	### 4. No Invocation Mechanism in Pipeline
106	
107	**Finding:** Searched entire `./shared/pipeline.md` (995 lines) for MASTER_PROMPT references:
108	
109	```bash
110	$ grep -i "MASTER_PROMPT\|Master Prompt" ./shared/pipeline.md
111	# (no results)
112	```
113	
114	**Gap:** The pipeline has no phase that says:
115	- "If ARCHITECTURE.md is missing, invoke MASTER_PROMPT"
116	- "Phase 2 applies architecture prompts for new projects"
117	- "Generate ARCHITECTURE.md before continuing"
118	
119	**What Phase 2 Actually Does (line 187-189):**
120	```markdown
121	1. Read `PROJECT_MAP.md` if it exists — extract `TECH_STACK` and `SYSTEM_FLOW`. 
122	   If absent, create it in Phase 7.
123	2. Ambiguity check
124	3. Time awareness
125	4. Scan root files to detect stack (package.json → Next.js/React/Vue, etc.)
126	```
127	
128	Phase 2 detects the stack (Next.js, React, Vue) but doesn't trigger architecture generation.
129	
130	---
131	
132	### 5. Reproductions Confirm Content Quality, Not File Creation
133	
134	**Test Projects Created:**
135	- `test-projects/nextjs-new/` — Next.js 14 App Router variant
136	- `test-projects/ios-new/` — iOS Swift/SwiftUI variant  
137	- `test-projects/android-new/` — Android Kotlin/Compose variant
138	
139	**Reproduction Results:**
140	
141	All three reproductions successfully generated comprehensive architecture plans:
142	- ✅ Stack detection worked (Next.js 14, iOS Swift, Android Kotlin)
143	- ✅ Phase-based implementation plans generated (Phase 0-4)
144	- ✅ All required topics covered (structure, data flow, state, styling, etc.)
145	- ✅ Risk documentation included
146	- ✅ Claude Code integration rules defined
147	
148	**But:**
149	- ❌ No ARCHITECTURE.md files created in any test project
150	- ❌ Content only exists in REPRODUCTION.md (manual documentation)

entries.content: Now let me check the ROOT_CAUSE document to understand what the proposed fixes were:

entries.detail:
150	- ❌ Content only exists in REPRODUCTION.md (manual documentation)
151	- ❌ Pipeline never invoked automatically
152	
153	From `build-progress.txt` (lines 57-62):
154	```
155	4. Need to investigate:
156	   - How these MASTER_PROMPTs are discovered/invoked in new projects
157	   - Whether pipeline Phase 1 handles missing ARCHITECTURE.md gracefully
158	   - If bootstrap flow needs explicit instructions or automation
159	```
160	
161	**Observation:** The MASTER_PROMPT content is excellent and complete. The problem is not WHAT it generates, but WHEN and HOW it gets invoked and persisted.
162	
163	---
164	
165	## Root Causes Summary
166	
167	| # | Root Cause | Evidence Location | Impact |
168	|---|---|---|---|
169	| 1 | **Missing Trigger Logic** | Pipeline Phase 1-2, SKILL.md line 155 | MASTER_PROMPT never runs automatically for new projects |
170	| 2 | **Ambiguous File Creation** | web/MASTER_PROMPT.md line 3 | Unclear if output should create file or return text |
171	| 3 | **Pipeline Asymmetry** | pipeline.md lines 177 vs 189 | PROJECT_MAP.md has fallback, ARCHITECTURE.md doesn't |
172	| 4 | **No Invocation Documentation** | All pipeline phases | No phase says "run MASTER_PROMPT when missing" |
173	| 5 | **Unvalidated Path** | documentation/WORKFLOW.md | New-project flow never tested end-to-end |
174	
175	---
176	
177	## Proposed Fix
178	
179	### Fix 1: Add Bootstrap Trigger to Phase 2
180	
181	**Location:** `./shared/pipeline.md`, Phase 2 (after stack detection, before Phase 3)
182	
183	**Add:**
184	```markdown
185	5. **Architecture Bootstrap (new projects only):**
186	   If `ARCHITECTURE.md` is missing from repo root:
187	   - Apply MASTER_PROMPT variant matching detected stack:
188	     - Web (Next.js/React/Vue) → `web/MASTER_PROMPT.md`
189	     - Mobile (iOS/Android/KMP) → `mobile/MASTER_PROMPT.md`
190	   - Generate comprehensive architecture decisions
191	   - Write to `ARCHITECTURE.md` at repo root
192	   - Report: "Created ARCHITECTURE.md for new [stack] project"
193	   
194	   If `ARCHITECTURE.md` exists: skip this step and proceed to Phase 3.
195	```
196	
197	**Rationale:** Phase 2 already detects stack and handles PROJECT_MAP.md fallback. Adding ARCHITECTURE.md creation here maintains symmetry and ensures architecture exists before Phase 3 (branch naming) begins.
198	
199	---
200	
201	### Fix 2: Make File Creation Explicit in MASTER_PROMPT
202	
203	**Location:** `./web/MASTER_PROMPT.md`, header section
204	
205	**Change from:**
206	```markdown
207	> **Use once per project** to lock architecture, conventions, and AI usage rules. 
208	> Pin decisions in `ARCHITECTURE.md` at the repo root.
209	```
210	
211	**To:**
212	```markdown
213	> **Use once per project** to lock architecture, conventions, and AI usage rules. 
214	> **Output:** Create `ARCHITECTURE.md` at the repo root containing all architectural 
215	> decisions. This file becomes the source of truth for the project.
216	
217	## Output Format
218	
219	When invoked for a new project, create `ARCHITECTURE.md` with the following structure:
220	
221	```markdown
222	# ARCHITECTURE.md
223	
224	> Source of truth for architecture decisions in this [Next.js/React/Vue] project.
225	> Generated: [date]
226	> Last Updated: [date]
227	
228	## Stack
229	[Framework, runtime, styling, deployment target]
230	
231	## [App Router Structure / Component Architecture]
232	[Server vs client boundaries, route organization, etc.]
233	
234	... (all sections from Phase 0-4 deliverables)
235	```
236	```
237	
238	**Rationale:** Removes ambiguity. Makes it clear that MASTER_PROMPT's job is to CREATE a file, not just describe what should be in it.
239	
240	---
241	
242	### Fix 3: Add ARCHITECTURE.md Fallback to Phase 1
243	
244	**Location:** `./shared/pipeline.md`, Phase 1 (line 177)
245	
246	**Change from:**
247	```markdown
248	2. Check for `ARCHITECTURE.md` → load architectural decisions and conventions
249	```

10	## Executive Summary
11	
12	The mobile MASTER_PROMPT bootstrap flow has **the same five critical gaps as web**, preventing it from working in new projects:

21	6. **Platform detection gap** — Pipeline Phase 2 detects iOS/Android/KMP stack but doesn't route to correct MASTER_PROMPT variant (A/B/C)
